notes.goal: Isolate foreground visible/physical I/O as an explicit demo compatibility path and compose backend production I/O without broad runtime backend_mode branching.
notes.critical_invariant: Production backend I/O failure must never silently fall back to foreground capture or physical input.
notes.composition_contract: Select explicit backend or foreground capture/input implementations once at the composition root. Downstream runtime components must not re-select I/O via backend_mode.
notes.launcher_contract: SteamGameLauncher owns process/window readiness, not mouse/input construction or runtime I/O mode selection.
notes.relaunch_contract: Game relaunch reuses the machine's selected capture/window dependency and must not reconstruct I/O from machine.backend_mode.
notes.test_contract: Mutable .backend_mode test toggling is not preserved. Add non-skipped deterministic launcher/relaunch composition coverage; skipped game-process lifecycle tests alone are insufficient.
notes.workflow: Final SPEC approved after OpenCode Scout evidence plus ChatGPT repository review. Gemini/Antigravity is the sole production implementation writer.
